title: Projects
text:
Data Scientist Careers: Skill Gaps & Prediction
Team project (AD688, Group 5) analyzing job postings for Data Scientist roles in Professional, Scientific & Technical Services (NAICS 5417). I led the skill gap analysis, comparing the skills employers ask for with what candidates bring, and the predictive modeling section, using Spark ML to model what drives salary.
Tools: PySpark · Spark ML · Plotly · Quarto · AWS EC2
GitHub





Salary Prediction with Spark ML
Built a full machine learning pipeline on the Met Career Compass job postings dataset: cleaning, feature engineering with StringIndexer, OneHotEncoder and VectorAssembler, then training linear, polynomial and random forest regression models. I compared them on RMSE, R², AIC and BIC, diagnosed multicollinearity in the linear models, and visualized feature importance and actual vs. predicted values.
Tools: PySpark · Spark ML · Seaborn · Plotly · AWS EC2
GitHub





Cloud Foundations on AWS
Completed the AWS Academy cloud curriculum alongside AD688. I configured and secured EC2 instances, built a VPC with a web server, set up IAM permissions, worked with EBS, S3 and RDS, and designed a highly available, fault-tolerant architecture. All of my Spark work for the course runs on a remote EC2 instance.
Tools: AWS EC2 · VPC · IAM · S3 · RDS · CloudWatch · Linux
GitHub

title: Victoria (Tori) Loukas
text:
I’m a graduate student in the M.S. in Applied Data Analytics at Boston University, finishing in December 2026, and a Contract Specialist at NAVSEA in Washington, DC. My work sits where data meets business decisions: I like taking large, messy datasets, building the pipeline that cleans them, and turning the results into something a decision-maker can act on.
In my coursework I work end to end in the cloud, processing data with PySpark on AWS EC2, building and comparing machine learning models in Spark ML, and publishing reproducible reports with Quarto. In my day job I see how careful analysis, clear documentation and attention to detail keep complex programs on track.
